```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# ----------------------------
# 1) Read + clean names
# ----------------------------
df <- read_csv("focal_group_comparison_main2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

names(df) <- names(df) %>%
  str_replace_all(" ", "_") %>%
  tolower()

# Identify measurement columns
zoo_cols   <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "^zoo_(count|rel)_")]
reads_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "^reads_")]              # absolute eDNA reads
edna_rel_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "^edna_.*_rel$")]     # relative eDNA reads

# Meta = everything else
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c(zoo_cols, reads_cols, edna_rel_cols))

# ----------------------------
# 2) Pivot zoo -> zoo_count / zoo_rel
# ----------------------------
zoo_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(zoo_cols),
    names_to = c("metric", "taxa"),
    names_pattern = "^zoo_(count|rel)_(.+)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxa   = str_to_lower(taxa),
    metric = if_else(metric == "count", "zoo_count", "zoo_rel")
  ) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(meta_cols)), taxa, metric) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

# ----------------------------
# 3) Pivot absolute eDNA reads: reads_* -> edna
# ----------------------------
edna_abs_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(reads_cols),
    names_to = "taxa",
    names_pattern = "^reads_(.+)$",
    values_to = "edna"
  ) %>%
  mutate(taxa = str_to_lower(taxa)) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(meta_cols)), taxa) %>%
  summarise(edna = sum(edna, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ----------------------------
# 4) Pivot relative eDNA reads: edna_*_rel -> edna_rel
# ----------------------------
edna_rel_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(edna_rel_cols),
    names_to = "taxa",
    names_pattern = "^edna_(.+)_rel$",
    values_to = "edna_rel"
  ) %>%
  mutate(taxa = str_to_lower(taxa)) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(meta_cols)), taxa) %>%
  summarise(edna_rel = sum(edna_rel, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Combine abs + rel eDNA
edna_long <- full_join(edna_abs_long, edna_rel_long, by = c(meta_cols, "taxa"))

# ----------------------------
# 5) Join zoo + eDNA -> final df_long
# ----------------------------
df_long <- full_join(zoo_long, edna_long, by = c(meta_cols, "taxa")) %>%
  mutate(
    zoo_count = replace_na(zoo_count, 0),
    zoo_rel   = replace_na(zoo_rel, 0),
    edna      = replace_na(edna, 0),
    edna_rel  = replace_na(edna_rel, 0),
    taxa = str_replace_all(taxa, "_", " "),
    taxa = str_squish(taxa),
    taxa = str_to_title(taxa)
  )

df_long

```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# 6) Plot: log10(zoo_rel) vs log10(edna_rel)
#    - Other in grey
# ============================================================
plot_df <- df_long %>%
# filter(zoo_rel > 0, edna_rel > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    log_rel_zoo   = log10(zoo_rel),
    log_rel_reads = log10(edna_rel)
  ) %>%
  filter(taxa != "Other") %>% 
  group_by(sample_code)


p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log_rel_zoo, y = log_rel_reads, colour = taxa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = taxa), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    groups = "Taxa",
    x = "Log10 relative zooplankton abundance",
    y = "Log10 relative eDNA reads",
    colour = NULL
  )

p

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

corr_tbl <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    spearman_rho = suppressWarnings(cor(zoo_rel, edna_rel, method = "spearman")),
    spearman_p   = suppressWarnings(cor.test(zoo_rel, edna_rel, method="spearman")$p.value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), desc(spearman_rho))

corr_tbl
corr_tbl %>% filter(n >= 10)

```

align_tbl <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    spearman_rho = suppressWarnings(cor(log_rel_zoo, log_rel_reads, method = "spearman")),
    pearson_r    = suppressWarnings(cor(log_rel_zoo, log_rel_reads, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(spearman_rho))

align_tbl

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Non-zero pairs (for correlation labels)
df_nz <- df_long %>%
  filter(zoo_rel > 0, edna_rel > 0)

# Per-taxa Spearman on non-zero pairs
rho_tbl <- df_nz %>%
  group_by(taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    rho = suppressWarnings(cor(zoo_rel, edna_rel, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("ρ = ", round(rho, 2), "\n", "n = ", n)
  )

# Data-driven pseudocounts (half smallest non-zero)
pc_zoo   <- min(df_long$zoo_rel[df_long$zoo_rel > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2
pc_reads <- min(df_long$edna_rel[df_long$edna_rel > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2

# Log-transform with pseudocount; flag zeros
plot_df0 <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    log_rel_zoo   = log10(zoo_rel + pc_zoo),
    log_rel_reads = log10(edna_rel + pc_reads),
    zero_pair = (zoo_rel == 0 | edna_rel == 0)
  )

ggplot(plot_df0, aes(x = log_rel_zoo, y = log_rel_reads)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = !zero_pair), size = 2) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 0.25, `FALSE` = 0.85), guide = "none") +
  geom_smooth(
    data = plot_df0 %>% filter(!zero_pair),
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm", se = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ taxa, scales = "free") +
  geom_text(
    data = rho_tbl,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Log10 relative zooplankton abundance",
    y = "Log10 relative reads"
  )

```

```{r}

plot_df_2 <- df_long %>% 
  mutate(
    date = dmy(str_replace_all(date, "_", "/")),  # handles 15_6_2021 or 15/6/2021
    day  = day(date),
    month = month(date),
    month_name = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = F),
    year = year(date),
    month_year_date = floor_date(date, "month"),
    month_year = format(month_year_date, "%b-%Y")
  ) %>%
  arrange(month_year) %>% 
  filter(month_year != "Jun-2021")

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)


# ensure Other is last
plot_df_2 <- plot_df_2 %>%
  mutate(taxa = fct_relevel(taxa, "Other", after = Inf))

# build a manual fill palette: grey for Other, default ggplot hues for the rest
taxa_levels <- levels(plot_df_2$taxa)
other_col <- "grey70"

pal_rest <- scales::hue_pal()(sum(taxa_levels != "Other"))
pal <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(taxa_levels)), taxa_levels)
pal[taxa_levels != "Other"] <- pal_rest
pal["Other"] <- other_col

ggplot(plot_df_2, aes(x = month_year_date, y = zoo_rel, fill = taxa)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b-%Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative Zooplankton abundance (cells/L)", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

        
```
